newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mainly boosted by better demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mainly boosted by better demand.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly firm on Friday, boosted by better demand, traders said.
Heating oil premiums firmed by $1.0-$2.0 to June IPE +$2.50/$3.50 fob Rotterdam on strong German demand, refinery run cuts and minor production problems,

Gasoline was firm with Eurograde barges trading twice for $202 fob AR, and once for running refinery Eurograde at $204 for first half June. Naphtha was flat in quiet trade with swaps at $203.50/4.50 for May and $187/88 for June.
Fuel oil slipped $1 as bunker demand fell away after Thursday's busy trade.
